title: scenarios(build): charge a standing security-rollup-source-unreadable warning when the card withholds the roll-up's child from a persona that can read the roll-up
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table, added by eval#1). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 ~11:22Z, verbatim on eval#1's decision card: 「改为搭建侧处理」. 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

`os build` reports `security-rollup-source-unreadable` (`packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts`) as a warning when a permission set can read a parent's roll-up field but not the child object, the aggregated child field, or a child field the roll-up's `filter` tests. The warning is advisory, so it never fails `os build`. The scenario runner's Build half (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` `buildHalf`, `half.commands`) passes the build with the warning still standing, and the Build score does not look at it.

On a card that withholds that child object or field from a persona (`run.personas[].hidden`) which may read the parent's roll-up, the standing warning means the built app still shows that persona an aggregate of the data the card hides. eval#1 found it in the build transcript of all 15 live `project_with_tasks` builds on main `3be13473` (2026-11-15).

## Why it matters

A build that leaves a hidden child readable through a roll-up scores full on Build, and then the Run half meets either a leak or a false "withheld" truth. The maintainer ruled that this is the build's fault and is to be charged on the Build side, not graded away at Run.

## Done when

- The Build half reads `security-rollup-source-unreadable` findings from the build output. A finding counts when the set it names belongs to a card persona and the card withholds that child object or field from that persona. A matching finding still standing when the build finishes is charged on Build, with a problem naming the persona, the roll-up field and the hidden child. A finding the card does not withhold is not charged.
- The scorecard shows the charge on the Build row, and the run record carries the finding.
- The check is deterministic and reads only the build's own output (cloud#3600 cost ruling). The thread measures first on eval#1's records (`/mnt/project-files/eval/runs/`) and reports how many builds the charge moves.
- Tests pin a charged build (the warning stands on a withheld child), an uncharged one (the parent summary is masked on the set, so no warning), and a warning on a child the card does not withhold (not charged).

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap (queue ①: `orchestrate.ts` / `scorecard.ts`). Its authoring-side twin, the skill that tells the builder to resolve the warning, is filed apart for the skills lane.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue security-rollup-source-unreadable` → 40 hits; the only open ones are #33595 (parent) and two PM seat posts (#6367, #6015). The closed hits are release sweeps and the rule's own landing (#31911 and its neighbours), none of which grades the warning in the scenario runner.
